defects.description: summarize records every summary in the per-tenant map that eviction never trims, so the summary released from the bounded entries stays retained and cacheEntryCount() grows past the limit.

trigger.input: import { SummaryCache } from "./src/summary.js"; const cache = new SummaryCache(); for (let i = 1; i <= 65; i++) cache.summarize("tenant-" + i, "2026-02-01", [{ amount: i }]); console.log(cache.cacheEntryCount());

defects.why_missed: The suite only asserts summaries, lookups, an eviction of the bounded map and a count taken exactly at the limit, so no test ever summarizes a 65th tenant-day and asks how many summaries are still retained.
